thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed at the edge -> upstream (us-west/eu-west). Escalation level: high. Paging rotation: natalie (oncall).

incident-bot: alert window: 2026-03-15T03:14Z, spike started ~5m ago. Metrics: gateway 504s up 12x, origin timeouts up 8x.

natalie (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing current dashboards. @omar can you join?

omar: on way. saw a surge in long tail latencies on the http-proxy pods. 95p latency jumping then many 504s.

jin: quick note — traces for these requests are mostly missing in X-Ray; request IDs not propagating for a lot of failed samples. looks like a header stripping issue at the LB -> proxy hop.

katy-support: 2 enterprise customers reported errors in production, one is chat-heavy (acct: acme-corp). support ticket 7892 opened and linked. customers see repeated failures for streaming requests.

natalie (oncall): assessment: high customer impact, region-aware. mitigation plan: 1) add temporary logging at gateway for incoming headers and response codes. 2) Route a small % of traffic to fallback gateway pool that keeps header passthrough. 3) Enable low-sample tracing on affected services.

omar: implementing 2) now — switching route weights to fallback pool (canary) at 10% to reduce blast radius.

jin: pushing a tiny stopgap snippet to gateway to log request ids when present. adding a feature-flag guarded log to avoid noise. patch command:

```
# ephemeral patch to gateway proxy config
kubectl -n edge patch configmap gateway-config --patch '{"data":{"enable_temp_header_log":"true"}}'
kubectl -n edge rollout restart deployment gateway-proxy
```

Please note: this is temporary, will be removed after triage.

omar: did the route change; now 10% to fallback. monitoring shows slight drop in error rate on fallback path.

sre-bot: metric alert muted for 15m while on-call performs mitigation (alert id: A-3392).

natalie (oncall): logs show many requests missing x-request-id between LB and proxy. likely regression from recent envoy filter update. jin, can you check the last envoy patch?

jin: confirmed — the envoy filter we rolled yesterday has a header-normalization step that accidentally set `x-request-id` to empty in some codepaths when `x-b3-*` exists. rolling hotfix to remove that transformation.

omar: rolling hotfix as a canary to 20% of proxies in us-west. command:

```
kubectl -n edge set image deployment/gateway-proxy gateway-proxy=registry.redwood/gateway-proxy:fix/keep-xreqid-20260315
kubectl -n edge rollout status deployment/gateway-proxy -w
```

Waiting for pods to become ready.

katy-support: acme-corp reports errors decreased after the route change. they still see some timeouts but volume reduced. sending interim update.

natalie (oncall): enabling low-sample tracing (1%) for the affected services now to capture end-to-end spans; trying to capture one failing trace with headers intact.

jin: tracing enabled. also flipped temporary ENV to keep additional debug logs: `EDGE_TEMP_LOG=1` for 5 minutes. logs show a pattern: long queues in kvcache lookup for a subset of keys, causing timeouts to origin. unclear why kvcache suddenly hot.

omar: I can throttle kv client parallelism as emergency mitigation. doing that now to reduce head-of-line blocking.

sre-bot: config change applied to kvclient pool (max_concurrency reduced) in us-west. watch for error regression/latency.

natalie (oncall): current status: error rate down ~60% from peak after routing + hotfix + kv throttle. customers seeing improvement. still partial impact. next steps: postmortem owner? jin or omar? also need to backfill missing traces/logs into runbook.

jin: I'll own the postmortem for the envoy filter + kvcache interaction. omar to lead mitigation playbook updates and add permanent golden signals for header-propagation.

katy-support: I'll follow up with acme-corp and the other impacted accounts with a timeline and RCA promise.

natalie (oncall): creating incident ticket and adding action items. follow-ups:
- immediate: remove temp logging after 30m and revert `EDGE_TEMP_LOG`
- short: full rollback of header normalization filter if root cause confirmed
- medium: add automated trace presence alert if request-id missing for >0.5% of requests
- long: review kvcache hotspotting and implement adaptive backpressure

omar: adding checklist to the incident ticket and assigning owners. will also attach the small patch snippet we used.

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial, customer impact reduced. new severity: sev2.

natalie (oncall): thanks team. if anything regresses, repage. otherwise we'll reconvene for a 30m post-incident triage in #incidents-review and cut a proper postmortem template. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
